hints.content:
Then we can show $144$ divided by the entire difference.

So, we must put the expression $\blueE{70-34}$ in 
parentheses.

$(\blueE{70-34})$

Then, we put the $\maroonD{144\text{ divided by}}$ before the parentheses:

$\maroonD{144\div}(\blueE{70-34})$

[[☃ explanation 1]]

options.explanation:
Unlike multiplication, division is not **commutative**. So the order matters.

$a \div144 \neq144 \div a$

hints.content: The expression $\maroonD{144\div}(\blueE{70-34})$ represents $144$ divided by the difference of the expression $70-34$.
